reason: A presentation-generation tool that converts Markdown into self-contained HTML slides with selectable themes, navigation, and local file output; the README states that it uses no network or external assets.

summaries.zh: 将 Markdown 内容转换为带主题、键盘导航和全屏控制的自包含 HTML 演示文稿。
summaries.en: Converts Markdown content into self-contained HTML presentations with selectable themes, keyboard navigation, and fullscreen controls.

capabilities: Converts Markdown input into a self-contained HTML slide deck
Splits Markdown into slides using separators or headings
Renders common Markdown elements including headings, lists, code blocks, links, and images
Applies deepseek, light, or dark themes
Writes the generated HTML deck to a user-specified output path
Provides browser keyboard navigation and fullscreen controls in the generated deck
